sinopsis.es: Deisy es una adolescente que cree haber encontrado en Felipe, un camionero mayor que ella, la oportunidad de escapar de casa. Pero su decisión tendrá consecuencias que la marcarán para siempre.
sinopsis.en: Deisy is a teenager who believes she has found in Felipe—a truck driver older than she is—a chance to run away from home. But her decision will have consequences that will shape her forever.
